name: Graves
notes: Opens with Collateral Damage (R) at t=0; the shell-hit and cone-explosion damage are both assumed to land on the single dummy target, the most common in-game reading when a champion stands point-blank in the cone (an open question in the dossier).

Basic attacks are New Destiny's 4-pellet spray (6 pellets on crit): the first pellet deals the full per-level AD ratio and each further pellet deals 0.333x of it, and a crit applies a reduced bonus multiplier (1 + 0.5*(critDamage-1)) to every pellet instead of the normal crit multiplier; because the engine models crit as an expected value, this is computed as a single blended expected-value hit per attack (attack_damage is overridden to 0 and the whole pellet instance is dealt in before_attack) rather than as discrete pellets or a discrete crit roll.

The per-level base pellet AD ratio is not resolvable from the bin (unresolved ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart) so it is computed directly from the wiki's stated formula 100*(0.6895+0.01765*x*(0.595+0.0225*(x-1)))% AD for levels 1-18 and stored as a by-level table.

The ammo system is modeled as: 2 shells, each attack spends one, and emptying the clip starts a flat 2.08 s reload during which Graves cannot attack; the 1-shell idle-then-1.3s-reload path never triggers because the rotation always attacks the instant it can. Reload speed's stated (and explicitly 'confusing', non-monotonic) scaling with bonus attack speed is not modeled; the flat base time is used throughout, per the dossier's own fallback option.

Quickdraw (E) is cast the instant it is off cooldown purely for its attack-reset and reload-1-shell effect (it deals no damage): if cast while reloading it cancels the reload and leaves 1 shell instead of 2, otherwise it tops the clip up by 1; either way it resets the attack timer. Its own cooldown ticks down 0.5 s per expected pellet landed (4 normal / 6 on crit, blended the same way as the passive) while it is on cooldown.

Q (End of the Line) is cast on cooldown: the initial pass deals its damage on cast, and the powder trail is assumed to detonate on the same stationary dummy 2 seconds later for its separate damage instance.
W (Smoke Screen) is cast on cooldown for its impact damage; travel time is not modeled beyond the usual 0.25 s cast lockout.

Mana is modeled as a single pool starting at the level-16 sheet's mana value with no regeneration (the fight is short); once a cast's cost cannot be paid, that ability stops being cast for the rest of the fight instead of looping. This is because Graves' four costed abilities can plausibly drain a level-16 mana pool inside 15 s.
True Grit's bonus armor/MR from Quickdraw only affects damage taken, not dealt, and is omitted.

assumed.why: the bin's per-level AD ratio formula is unresolved; the 18 values are computed directly from the wiki's quoted closed-form formula instead
assumes the cone explosion also lands on the same single dummy already hit by the direct shell, since the dossier leaves this open and a point-blank single target is the common reading
